videos.scopeEn: Related background for Silicon wafer wire sawing. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「辨識晶向」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。

videos.after: 把「總厚度變異」列為查證任務：檢查結果是否能支持「TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Measure total thickness variation: Check whether the evidence supports: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

guides.title: 矽晶圓線鋸切片：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon wafer wire sawing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識晶向」建立判讀邊界。晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify crystal orientation to define the interpretation boundary. Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識晶向：檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜總厚度變異：檢查結果是否能支持「TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜切片批次放行：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度、損傷、邊緣與追溯證據須同時交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify crystal orientation: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure total thickness variation: Check whether the evidence supports: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release a slicing lot: Check whether the evidence supports: Release requires thickness, damage, edge and traceability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「總厚度變異」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「切片批次放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure total thickness variation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release a slicing lot to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「總厚度變異」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure total thickness variation and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

diagram.title: 矽晶圓線鋸切片：概念與證據關係
diagram.titleEn: Silicon wafer wire sawing: concepts and evidence
diagram.alt: 本課四個技術單元與建模、觀察、診斷、放行證據之間的關係。
diagram.altEn: Relationships among four technical units and model, observation, diagnosis and acceptance evidence.

related.transfer: 切片留下的損傷與形貌會成為拋光及磊晶的來料條件。
related.transferEn: Slicing damage and geometry become incoming conditions for polishing and epitaxy.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是切縫、TTV、次表面損傷；「晶圓研磨與拋光」則以晶圓研磨與拋光為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes kerf, ttv and subsurface damage; Wafer lapping and polishing treats wafer lapping and polishing as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出矽晶圓線鋸切片與晶圓研磨與拋光之間的材料或資料交接
用「辨識晶向」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項切縫、TTV、次表面損傷的觀察，說明還需哪個晶圓研磨與拋光證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Silicon wafer wire sawing and Wafer lapping and polishing
Use identify crystal orientation to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from kerf, ttv and subsurface damage and state which additional Wafer lapping and polishing evidence is needed for acceptance
